entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your phantom’s strength is fueled by your own diverse experiences and abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Phantom class feature.

Benefit(s): The abilities of your phantom are calculated as though you were 4 class levels higher, to a maximum effective spiritualist level equal to your character level.
